fda_regulatory_assessment.regulatory_guidance: FDA Non-Clinical Engineering Tests for Bioresorbable Vascular Scaffolds (2020 Guidance)
key_concerns: Radial force maintenance during vascular remodeling

required_standard_tests: ISO 10993-3: Genotoxicity, Carcinogenicity, and Reproductive Toxicity
ISO 10993-10: Tests for Skin Sensitization and Irritation
ISO 10993-13/15: Identification and Quantification of Degradation Products
iso_10993_biocompatibility_audit.recommendation: Complies with biological evaluation safety parameters for FDA premarket notification.

conclusion: Candidate polymer 'PLLA' demonstrates acceptable biocompatibility under ISO 10993 with sufficient mechanical scaffolding modulus (1.59 GPa remaining at 18 months). Clearance pathway follows FDA Class III (PMA Required) guidelines.
